## RE:volution Resource Pack v1.1.0

This release redesigns the Poison rune texture set and introduces distribution in two resolutions.

### Added

- Redesigned all 11 unique Poison rune textures in a unified detailed pixel-art style.
- Added official 64x64 and 128x128 resource pack variants.
- Added validation and separate ZIP packaging for both resolutions.

### Fixed

- No separate bug fixes are recorded for this release.

### Other

- Both variants use version v1.1.0 and identical file names and resource paths.
- Preserved the `customguimod` namespace and compatibility with all 26 fixed rune positions.
- Verified transparent RGBA PNGs and tested both variants in Minecraft 1.12.2, as recorded in the original release notes.
- This documentation update does not claim a new in-game test pass.
- The pack contains Poison rune images only. Separate rank, status, type, button and other GUI texture categories remain planned.
- Gameplay logic, GUI geometry and rune state are controlled by the RE:volution mod.

### Download

Choose one of the attached resource packs for Minecraft 1.12.2:

- `re-volution-resource-pack-v1.1.0-64x64.zip` — lower texture memory usage.
- `re-volution-resource-pack-v1.1.0-128x128.zip` — higher texture resolution.

Both variants use identical resource paths. Enable one variant in the client's resource pack settings.

**Full Changelog:** [v1.0.0...v1.1.0](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-resource-pack/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0)
